profile.headline: Software Engineer with civic tech and digital humanities experience.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
My primary interests lie at the intersection of Digital Humanities, archives, history, and computing. I have worked in this capacity for the better part of a decade, and continue to look for exciting and simulating opportunities that combine the creation of new knowledge with tools available via the medium of computing.
  
I am also interested in roles that deal with addressing large social issues like the climate crisis.
  
My technical competencies center around web (in particular frontend) development. I have experience with many associated libraries and frameworks (React, Node, etc), as well as deep experience with Javascript, Python, and Smalltalk.
  
I have given several talks and presentations on these topics, and have also been published in "The Los Angeles Review of Books" and "The Encyclopedia of American Recessions and Depressions"

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on modernizing the National Weather Service's web and related data services, continuing the work started at 18F

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with federal agencies to improve public service software, infrastructure, and development practices (see https://18f.org for more information)
- At login.gov -- the federal government's in-house identity provider -- I worked on the team handling the "identity proofing" flow, where users securely link their real-life identity information with their online accounts
- Served as Engineering Lead on NOAA's project to create the next generation of the National Weather Service's public website (currently at beta.weather.gov)
- Assisted in the production and re-platforming of 18F's well-respected guides series

positions.title: Computing Systems Researcher
positions.description:
- Researched end-user authorship systems as part of UnitedLex's Idea Factory Lab group.
- Created the Simpletalk authoring language and environment (build in OhmJS, Javascript, HTML, and vanilla web components)
- Drafted a long-term research proposal concerning new kinds of personal computing environments based on the concept of "layered metaphors"

positions.title: COO / Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Merriam is a non-deterministic system for exploring large volumes of information using what we call "narrative search."
  
At Merriam, I:
- Assisted in the strategy and design of the narrative search system
- Implememented front end user interfaces to the system, in particular the web application (written in NodeJS, MongoDB, React, HTML, and CSS).
- Added custom user interface features such as live annotation on the web
- Conducted client assessments and designed prototypes based on their needs
- Handled correspondence with vendors for logistics and bill payments
- Assisted in the management of cloud infrastructure on AWS

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
The History Lab project (formerly the Declassification Engine) is an interdisciplinary effort to bring computational methods to bear on large volumes of archival information. It also seeks to conduct research and build tools that will help the government in its mandate to declassify more of the public record.
  
As Project Manager I:
- Assisted in the development and management of the largest single repository of declassified documents available in one place (MySQL, Python)
- Created standards and initial libraries for streamlining our data ingestion and processing pipelines (MySQL, Python, nginx, NodeJS)
- Built and managed portions of the website and web application (BackboneJS, Javascript, HTML, CSS)
- Managed student researchers, including assessing work towards project goals
- Managed the project budget
- Assisted in drafting grant applications
- Handled conference and event logistics
- Conducted meetings and kept weekly lab group minutes
- Attended meetings with NARA, the Public Interest Declassification Board, the State Department, the CIA, and other organizations interested in the intersection of computing and declassification
- Presented on our group's work at meetings/conferences

positions.title: Summer Hire
positions.description:
Summer Hire for the US Army's institute for social science research
- Edited and proofread research drafted by ARI
- Created indexes for books tapped for future publication
- Independently developed an Access database in order to replace an unnecessarily complex and time-consuming internal report process, which improved uniformity and efficiency.

positions.title: Immigration Compliance Analyst (Intelligence Analyst II)
positions.description:
Immigration compliance analyst with Top Secret Clearance
- Regularly supported sensitive investigations
- Mastered several legacy intelligence systems
- Oversaw own task that involved independently managing inter-agency investigations and problem resolution
- When needed, took on supervisory duties

positions.title: Productions Intern
positions.description:
Productions intern
- Logged video and organized media library
- Assisted on-set with actual productions of television commercials, series, and documentaries
- Assisted in script fact-checking
